name: Ramapo Create & Explore Camp
description_short: Ramapo town day camp for children entering grades 1 to 8 at Summit Park Elementary School in New City, mixing arts and crafts, sports, games and dance, with two afternoons a week at Spook Rock Pool and trips such as Lake Compounce and Dave & Buster's.
refund_policy_summary: Refund requests go in writing to the Parks & Recreation Department; medical refunds need a doctor's note. No refunds once a program has begun, and a $50 per camper surcharge applies to cancellations.

fees.name: Payment plan fee
fees.note: Per family, only for families who choose the payment plan (minimum $500 deposit, in person, started by May 15)

fees.name: Late enrollment increase
fees.note: Charged on new enrollments after June 12, 2026 ($50 for incomplete payment plans)

fees.name: Cancellation surcharge
fees.note: Per camper, charged on a refund for a cancelled camp

notes: Price is the non-resident rate ($1,075); Ramapo residents pay $950. Non-residents could register from April 13 if space allowed. Camp page gives hours as 8:30 am to 3:30 pm, the registration form 9 am to 3:30 pm; extended day 3:30 to 5:30 pm ($250).
